title: I Want to Be Banished, but Everyone Likes Me Too Much!
description:
After dying the day after his high school entrance ceremony, Rokuto Azuma is reincarnated in another world with the seemingly unremarkable skill Storage. A goddess tells him he has a hidden power, but it can only awaken after he experiences a quintessential isekai event. To Rokuto, the answer is obvious: he needs to be banished from his party!
His teammates are two beautiful women and a handsome young man, all exceptionally powerful. Getting them to kick him out should be easy— except they all like him too much.
author: Yuui Hinami
